title: Property Manager — Urban Heaven site tour

site.name: Urban Heaven
site.publicReference: Listed publicly as a residential plot layout in Veerapandi, RERA TN/11/Layout/3675/2024 (ghar.tv listing); not yet confirmed by Bright as the same project

confirmed.title: Whole experience sits under the title 'Property Manager'; a cab picks the client up
confirmed.afterKnmMills: From Thudiyalur: turn left at KNM Mills; within ~700–800 m turn right; within ~500 m turn left; straight road; Urban Heaven appears; the car enters the site
confirmed.mettupalayamSide: Same structure from the Mettupalayam end
confirmed.next: Site map will be added after arrival (Bright to supply)
confirmed.car: 19 Nov: outside view = an SUV similar in class to a Fortuner, our own design (no purchased model, no copy of Toyota styling); inside view as built is OK
confirmed.realism: 19 Nov: Bright will send reference photos of the road layout and roadside buildings; target ~50–60% real look using them. Real dashcam footage / Google imagery not being used for now
confirmed.interior: 19 Nov (later): earlier interior looked cartoonish; Bright wants it to feel like sitting inside a real SUV — seats, dashboard, banner
confirmed.referencePhotos: 19 Nov: Bright sent 3 reference photos of a premium Indian-market SUV (dashboard, seats, black front exterior) as the look to follow. Not stored in the public repo; used for colours/materials/layout only. No logos, model name or exact grille/lamp design copied
confirmed.insideOnly: 19 Nov 09:51: customers see ONLY the inside-the-cab experience (no outside view). Goal: feel real; Bright and Claude check realism together before the link goes to customers. Bright sent 13 reference photos (front windscreen views, passenger window, rear-seat views) and will supply/generate more on request
confirmed.photoCockpit: Rev uh5: default view is Bright's front reference photo (passenger/centre view of a premium SUV cabin) with the windscreen cut out; road rendered behind, live route drawn on the photo's touchscreen
confirmed.seat360: 19 Nov 10:20 (supersedes 10:04 back-seat request): customer sits in the FRONT passenger seat; front view is the main view; 360° look-around kept; Olivetree Builders branding inside the car
confirmed.mapTour: 19 Nov 11:21: drop the 3D in-car experience. Top-view map: customer picks Thudiyalur or Mettupalayam, a cab travels on the map through each stop, enters the site, then the map zooms into the site
confirmed.speed: 19 Nov 11:52 (supersedes 11:45): 150–160 km/h on the highway, no slowing at stops (boards highlighted instead); speed limit 80 km/h from the KNM Mills turn to the site
confirmed.mettupalayamStops: 19 Nov 12:00: Mettupalayam side needs more highlighted areas (Teachers Colony, Karamadai, …) so the longer ride doesn't feel empty
confirmed.phase2Layout: 20 Nov: after entering the site, show the Phase 2 layout (Veerapandi Phase 2 Layout - A4.pdf, DTCP No. 25/2025) in 3D with graphical animations
confirmed.realSurroundings: 20 Nov 16:24: 3D layout surroundings looked cartoonish — make them real (real trees, grassland); an engaging 2D/toon look acceptable as fallback. Done with real satellite imagery

approximations.kilometreMarks: Highway km marks are estimates (public locality coordinates + ~26 km Thudiyalur–Mettupalayam): NGGO 1.6, Narasimhanaickenpalayam 4.0, Periyanaickenpalayam 7.0, Santhaimedu/KNM 9.0, Karamadai 17.0, Mettupalayam 26.0
approximations.sideRoad: Legs modelled as 0.75 km and 0.5 km (Bright's ranges); final straight 0.3 km is a placeholder
approximations.spelling: 'Sandimad' is shown as 'Santhaimedu' (சந்தைமேடு) — assumed, needs confirmation
approximations.mettupalayamTurn: From the Mettupalayam side the turn at KNM Mills is modelled as RIGHT (same side road approached from the north) — derived, needs confirmation
approximations.mettupalayamStops: Only Karamadai shown between Mettupalayam and Santhaimedu — stop list not yet given
approximations.scenery: Road, trees, buildings, KNM Mills sheds, gate arch, hills and plot kerbs are illustrative, not survey data
approximations.car: Original SUV (suv.js), gloss black: own trapezoid grille with chrome frame, three chrome bars and rectangular dark mesh; slim LED headlamps with twin chrome projectors and DRL strip; fog lamps in black recesses; silver skid plate; roof rails; yellow PROPERTY MANAGER door decals and roof sign; yellow URBAN HEAVEN plates
approximations.interior: Procedural cabin (interior.js) styled after Bright's references: dark chocolate leather with light contrast stitching (seats, door inserts, dash band, armrests), perforated seat inserts, black soft-touch dash top, chrome-bezel vents and centre clock, piano-black centre stack framed by stitched leather pillars with screen (live route), blue climate LCD and chrome knobs, dark wood console with chrome gear gate, black wheel with silver lower spokes and button pads (plain hub, no logo), blue-ring dials, beige roof lining with grab handles and dome lights, black carpet, split 2nd row with armrest, PROPERTY MANAGER windscreen sun strip. No driver figure
approximations.branding: Olivetree Builders text wordmark with a simple leaf mark drawn by us (not an official logo): front seatbacks + headrests, rear floor mats, windscreen sun strip, touchscreen header, cluster, page header. Replace with the official logo file when Bright supplies it
approximations.mapTour: Road geometry from OSRM/OpenStreetMap. Highway leaves Mettupalayam Road at 11.18607, 76.96040 (road junction leading to the pin; taken as the KNM Mills turn — not confirmed by name). Real side roads: west ~0.93 km, right, ~80 m, left, ~0.4 km to the 12.2 m Panchayat road, left (south) ~0.12 km, right into the 9.0 m road. Thudiyalur 14.4 km, Mettupalayam 17.0 km in total
approximations.speed: Displayed km/h; playback 10× real time (Thudiyalur ride ≈ 34 s, Mettupalayam ≈ 54 s). Eases 155→80 over the 600 m before the KNM turn; rolls in to the gate from 80. Board highlight: 600 m before to 400 m after each stop (~2 s on screen)
approximations.mettupalayamRoute: Mettupalayam leg now from the bus stand along the old Mettupalayam–Coimbatore Road via Teachers Colony (OSM bus stop), Karamadai bus stand, Kalattiyur (OSM village; Tamil name not shown — unconfirmed), joining NH181 to the KNM turn: 17.5 km road + ~1.6 km side road. No named localities in OSM between Kalattiyur and KNM (~7 km); Bright to add any he wants
approximations.phase2: 3D plot shapes traced from the indicative drawing (scale from 29'10" x 37'5" plot pitch, 0.176 m/px). Plots 1, 14, 27, 40, 46 are drawn off the table areas in the PDF itself; 3D follows the drawing, plot cards show the table. Entrance arch assumed on the 9.0 m road at the Panchayat road; compound wall on N/W/S sides; surroundings are real Esri World Imagery (z15/z17/z19 rings, live, attributed) centred on the APPROXIMATE site position (30 m west of the modelled gate) — until the gate pin arrives, the imagery under/around the layout is the nearby area, not the exact land. Layout orientation: north up as drawn — not yet aligned to the real site on the map; placed from the pin: north-up, Panchayat road centre on the pin longitude, layout centred on the pin latitude — position/rotation of the boundary on the land not surveyed
